headline: Ripple Expands Prime Services for 24/7 Stock Trading Using RLUSD Collateral
summary: Ripple is bringing institutions into 24/7 stock trading through Ripple Prime, allowing participants to post its RLUSD stablecoin as collateral, though HSBC warns markets remain thin.
why: Ripple provides enterprise blockchain and cross-border settlement solutions for financial institutions globally.

impacts.name: Digital Assets
impacts.why: Integration of stablecoin collateral into prime brokerage services expands institutional utility for digital tokens.
